title: Sahaay AI Phase 20: Emergency-Mode Feasibility & Readiness Audit Report

prerequisites.governing_body: Disaster Management Act (2005) & GHMC Municipal Act
prerequisites.legal_or_operational_status: Autonomous automated dispatch of municipal rescue fleets or road closures without magistrate order is legally prohibited
prerequisites.operational_constraints: Software must remain decision-support advisory only; cannot initiate physical dispatch

prerequisites.prerequisite_name: GHMC Disaster Response Force (DRF) Bilateral Protocol
prerequisites.governing_body: GHMC Disaster Management Wing (Directorate of EV&DM)
prerequisites.legal_or_operational_status: Bilateral data-sharing and incident escalation MoU pending institutional review
prerequisites.operational_constraints: Zero programmatic dispatch tickets or incident response webhooks configured

prerequisites.prerequisite_name: Hyderabad Traffic Police Central Command Protocol
prerequisites.governing_body: Hyderabad City Police / Cyberabad Police Traffic Branch
prerequisites.legal_or_operational_status: Operational protocol for automated waterlogged barricade advisory pending joint committee review
prerequisites.operational_constraints: No live feed for official barricade notices or traffic diversions

prerequisites.legal_or_operational_status: Dedicated 24/7 human dispatcher desk unstaffed in current repository deployment
prerequisites.operational_constraints: Human resolution workflow implemented in software, but operational duty shifts unstaffed

unresolved_blockers: Autonomous emergency dispatch is strictly prohibited under the Disaster Management Act (2005) without executive magistrate authorization.
Zero executed bilateral agreements exist with GHMC Disaster Response Force (DRF) for automated incident intake.
Zero programmatic links exist with Hyderabad Traffic Police for automated barricade or road closure instructions.
No 24/7 municipal human operator desk is certified and active to review P1/P2 escalated incidents.
prerequisites_to_unblock: Execute formal bilateral data-sharing and incident escalation agreement with GHMC Directorate of EV&DM.
Establish an authenticated webhook protocol with Hyderabad Traffic Police Central Command for verified waterlogging notices.
Staff and certify a 24/7 municipal operator review desk with trained duty officers holding AuthorizedReviewerRole credentials.
Conduct a joint mock tabletop exercise with GHMC DRF and Traffic Police validating human-in-the-loop incident resolution.
